howItWorks.title: How ordering works
howItWorks.metaTitle: How to order packaging from getpack — 6 steps from design to delivery
howItWorks.metaDescription: Ordering boxes and packaging from getpack: pick a style, enter your size, see the price at once, design or upload artwork, prepress checks and proofs it, pay a deposit, then follow production to your door.
howItWorks.answer: Ordering from getpack takes six steps: choose a box style and enter your size → see the price and delivery date at once → design in the studio or upload a file → prepress checks it and sends a proof to approve → pay the deposit to start production → follow production and delivery from your order page. Every step shows its status in your account.
howItWorks.intro: No waiting for quotes, no files going back and forth by email — everything is on one page, and you always see where the job is.

steps.title: Choose a style and enter your size
steps.body: Pick from a library of boxes, bags, pouches and labels that we really make. Enter your product's size and the sheet unfolds with cut lines, creases and safe zones. The dieline is free to download.
steps.tip: Not sure which style fits? Enter the product size and let the system suggest one, or message the team on LINE.

steps.title: See the price and delivery date at once
steps.body: Change the board, quantity or print and the unit price and total (VAT included) follow immediately, with production days and the earliest delivery date. Products that cannot be priced instantly can be quoted from the same page; the team answers in business hours.
steps.tip: Compare several quantities on the order step — the larger the run, the lower the unit price.

steps.title: Design in the studio, or upload a file
steps.body: Place your logo, text and images on a 3D box. The studio checks resolution, safe zones and unprintable colours while you design. Or upload an existing PDF/AI and we check it the same way. If you would rather not design yourself, getpack's design team works from what you placed.
steps.tip: Share a link so your team can comment on the 3D box. Every version is kept and can be restored.

steps.title: Prepress checks the file and sends a proof
steps.body: A person checks every job before it prints; if something will not look right, we say so first. You approve the proof on your order page or ask for changes, and can order a single sample box before the whole run.
steps.tip: Production starts only once the proof is approved.

steps.title: Pay the deposit to start production
steps.body: Pay by PromptPay QR, bank transfer, credit/debit card; if an order is paid in stages, the stages are shown before you confirm. The tax invoice is issued by Collective Group (Thailand) as soon as you pay. Business customers can apply for credit terms.
steps.tip: Enter your tax-invoice details once in your account and use them on every order.

steps.title: Follow production and receive your order
steps.body: See every stage on the order page: job received, printing, quality check, shipped — with QC photos before the cartons are sealed. When it arrives, confirm receipt or report a problem within the window shown on the order.
steps.tip: Reorder a past job in one click; approved artwork is not re-checked.

faq.a: It depends on the product. The minimum is shown on the product page and on the order step before you confirm; most products start in the hundreds of pieces.
Production days are shown with the price on the order step, counted in business days after the proof is approved and the deposit paid. The earliest delivery date is shown too.

faq.q: I have no artwork — what now?
faq.a: Design it free in the studio, placing your logo, text and images on a 3D box, or let getpack's design team work from what you placed.

faq.q: Can I get a sample first?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a sample box from the order step or your order page, choose photos or delivery, then confirm the full run.
PromptPay QR, bank transfer, credit/debit card. Approved business customers can order on credit terms.

faq.q: Something is wrong with the delivery — what do I do?
faq.a: Report it from the order page within the window shown, with photos of the product and the shipping carton. The team reviews it and offers a remedy such as a reprint, refund or store credit under our guarantee.

about.title: About getpack
about.metaTitle: About getpack — online packaging production platform by Collective Group (Thailand)
about.metaDescription: getpack is an online platform for ordering boxes, bags, pouches and labels in Thailand, operated by Collective Group (Thailand). Design it yourself, see the price at once, prepress checks every job, and it is made to getpack's production standard.
about.answer: getpack is an online packaging production platform in Thailand, operated by Collective Group (Thailand). It lets small and mid-size brands design boxes, bags, pouches and labels themselves, see prices and delivery dates instantly, have every job checked by a prepress team, and have it made to getpack's production standard, with quality controlled on every job.
about.lead: We believe a small brand deserves a box that looks like a big one — without knowing a printer, waiting for quotes, or guessing how the job will turn out.

sections.title: What we do
sections.body: getpack is one place from design to delivery: a library of box styles that can really be made, a design studio on a 3D box, prices that follow your spec at once, a prepress team that checks every file before print, and production and delivery tracking at every stage. Every tax invoice and document is issued by Collective Group (Thailand).

sections.title: Production standard
sections.body: Every job meets getpack's production standard. Our people inspect and photograph every batch before the cartons are sealed, and getpack is the seller responsible to you for the job.

sections.title: Why instant prices
sections.body: The price in the studio is the price you can order at, calculated from the board, size, quantity and print you chose, with nothing added later. Where a product cannot be priced instantly we say so and answer the quote within business hours.

sections.title: For businesses
sections.body: A business account reorders in one click, has several approvers, separate branches and delivery addresses, credit terms on request, and brand assets shared across the team.

free.q: Is it really free? What's the condition?
free.a: Every module is free with unlimited users. The condition: open a factory account and sign the partner agreement with getpack before you start.

data.q: Who owns my factory's customer data?
data.a: Customers your factory finds itself and records in getpack Factory are your factory's data; getpack does not use them to contact or sell to anyone. The getpack team can look into your system only while the owner grants access, and every look is logged for the owner to see. Customers that come through getpack jobs are getpack's customers; your factory receives only what it needs to produce that job.

names.q: Does getpack disclose partner factories' names?
names.a: No. Names, locations and factory data are never shown to customers or anyone outside; customer documents are issued in getpack's name, and nothing that reaches the customer carries the factory's name or logo. The full terms are in the partner agreement.

nonSolicit.q: Can we contact a customer we met through a getpack job?
nonSolicit.a: No. During the agreement and for 12 months after it ends, your factory may not contact or sell directly to customers it came to know through getpack jobs. Customers your factory finds itself are not covered.

accounting.q: Can it replace our accounting software?
accounting.a: getpack Factory has accounting and a general ledger built in; sales, purchase and payment documents post automatically. While you move over, use it alongside your current program. See the accounting module's status above.

modules.q: Can we use only some modules?
modules.a: Yes. Start with jobs from getpack and switch other modules on when you are ready.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using getpack, operated by Collective Group (Thailand): ordering, prices, payment, proof approval, production, delivery, guarantee and claims.

sections.title: 1. The provider
sections.body: getpack is provided by Collective Group (Thailand) ("the Company", "we"). The Company is the seller and issues tax invoices to customers directly. Using the site or placing an order means you accept these terms.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.body: You identify yourself with a mobile number or a third-party account. You are responsible for what happens under your account and must tell us at once if you suspect unauthorised use. A business account may grant access to several members; its administrator is responsible for their actions.

sections.title: 3. Prices and quotes
sections.body: Prices are in Thai baht, include VAT and exclude delivery unless stated. An instantly calculated price is the price you can order at for that spec and quantity at that moment. Quotes and saved prices are valid to the date shown. If a price changes before you confirm, the new price is shown for you to confirm again.

sections.title: 4. Orders and proof approval
sections.body: An order takes effect when you confirm it on the checkout page. Printing starts only once you approve the proof and pay the stage due. You are responsible for the correctness of your artwork and text and for the rights to images, logos and fonts used. The Company checks technical print readiness but is not responsible for spelling or content you have approved.

sections.title: 5. Payment
sections.body: Pay through the methods shown at checkout: PromptPay QR, bank transfer, credit/debit card. An order may be split into stages shown before you confirm. An order past its payment deadline is not cancelled automatically; the price is checked again at the date of payment before you pay. Business customers approved for credit terms pay as agreed.

sections.title: 6. Production and tolerances
sections.body: Print and packaging work carries industry-standard tolerances: the delivered quantity may be above or below the ordered quantity within the range shown on the order (charged at the actual quantity), dimensions may vary within the range shown, and printed colours may differ from a screen. Production days are business days after proof approval and payment.

sections.title: 7. Delivery and receipt
sections.body: We deliver to the address you give; delivery charges are shown before you confirm. On receipt, please inspect the goods and confirm receipt on the order page. If you neither confirm nor report a problem within the window shown, the order is treated as complete.

sections.title: 8. Guarantee and claims
sections.body: If goods are defective in manufacture or damaged in transit, report it from the order page within the window shown, with photos of the goods and the shipping carton. The Company reviews it and offers a remedy such as a reprint, refund or store credit as set out on the guarantee page. Defects arising from artwork or content you approved are not covered.

sections.title: 9. Cancellation
sections.body: An order can be cancelled free of charge before production starts. Once production has started, cancellation depends on the stage reached and the costs incurred, which the team tells you first.

sections.title: 10. Intellectual property
sections.body: You keep ownership of designs, logos and content you create or upload, and grant the Company and the producers acting for it the right to use them to produce your order. getpack's box styles, design tools and software belong to the Company.

sections.title: 11. Personal data
sections.body: We collect and use personal data under our Privacy Notice and the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562.

sections.title: 12. Limitation of liability
sections.body: The Company's liability for any order is limited to the value of that order. The Company is not liable for indirect loss, lost profit, or delay caused by events beyond its control.

sections.title: 13. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Thai law and disputes fall under the Thai courts. The Company may update these terms; the current version is shown on this page with its date.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice (PDPA)
privacy.metaDescription: getpack's privacy notice under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, by Collective Group (Thailand): what we collect, why, the legal basis, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and your rights.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Collective Group (Thailand), operator of getpack, is the controller of your personal data. Contact us about personal data through the contact page.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body: Account data (name, mobile number, email, customer type), tax-invoice details and delivery addresses, order data, payment data (we never store full card numbers; the payment provider processes them), artwork and designs you create, messages you exchange with the team, and site usage data according to your cookie choice.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
sections.body: To perform the contract: taking orders, production, delivery, tax documents and after-sales service. To comply with the law: accounting, tax and record keeping. Legitimate interest: system security, fraud prevention and service improvement. With your consent: news and offers by email, LINE or SMS, and analytics cookies — withdrawable at any time under Account › Privacy.

sections.title: 4. Who we share it with
sections.body: Only as needed: the producer making your order (recipient name, delivery address, artwork), carriers, payment providers, cloud and messaging providers, and public authorities where the law requires. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: 5. Transfers abroad
sections.body: Some service providers may store data outside Thailand. We select providers with adequate safeguards and data-processing agreements as the law requires.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: Account data is kept for the life of the account and for a period after closure for claims and disputes. Accounting and tax records are kept for the statutory period. Files uploaded for a check and never ordered are deleted automatically 90 days after their last change. The artwork and designs of an order are kept so you can reorder, and as support for accounting and tax records. Your files and designs are deleted on request, except what the law requires us to keep; send the request through the contact page and we answer within 30 days of receiving it.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You may access, copy, correct, delete, restrict, object, port and withdraw consent. Exercise them under Account › Privacy or by contacting us, and you may complain to the Personal Data Protection Committee office.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.body: We use encryption in transit, role-based access control and access logging. Staff and partners see only the data their work needs.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.body: We may update this notice. For significant changes we tell you in the system and ask for consent again where the law requires.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.metaDescription: Cookies used by the getpack website: essential cookies for sign-in and the cart, and analytics cookies enabled only with your consent, plus how to change your choice.

sections.title: What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser to remember your sign-in and settings and to measure use.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.body: Needed for the site to work: secure sign-in, the cart, your language and theme, and protection against attacks. These need no consent and cannot be turned off.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
sections.body: Used to understand which pages are hard to use and improve the service. Enabled only when you accept in the cookie bar. The data is not identifying and is not used for advertising.

sections.title: Changing your choice
sections.body: Change your consent at any time under Account › Privacy, or delete cookies in your browser settings.
